# MainMenu Apps Display

## Problem
MainMenu.vue doesn't list all apps and there's no routing for single app views.

## Solution
1. Query available apps from workspace
2. Display apps in MainMenu
3. Create route `/apps/:appId` for single app view
4. Add navigation handler in MainMenu
5. Ensure mobile compatibility

## Files to Modify
- `src/components/main-menu/MainMenu.vue` - Add apps list
- `src/router/index.ts` - Add app route

## Acceptance Criteria
- ✅ All apps listed in MainMenu
- ✅ Apps have clickable routes
- ✅ Single app view route exists
- ✅ Mobile and desktop compatible
- ✅ Icons and labels displayed properly
